identitySignals: California Secretary of State filing data (bizprofile.net) lists 'Infinity Communications & Consulting, Inc.', a General Corporation, active, at 4909 Calloway Drive, Suite 102, Bakersfield, CA, matching the agenda name and the Bakersfield, CA location

BBB lists 'Infinity Communications & Consulting, Inc.' in Bakersfield as a technology and E-rate consultant with phone (661) 716-1840 and fax (661) 716-1841, which are the same phone and fax numbers shown on infinitycomm.com (Infinity Communications & Compliance)
infinitycomm.com describes E-Rate, technology design and project administration services for schools, matching OUSD's 'Technology' contract category with the Technology Services Department
research.notes: The legal name in California filing data is 'Consulting, Inc.' while the website uses 'Compliance'. No page found explicitly states a rename; the link rests on the shared phone and fax numbers, same city, and same line of business. The website lists a P.O. box; the street address in filings is 4909 Calloway Dr, Suite 102, Bakersfield, CA 93312. The opengovco.com entity number 20201900732 is a Colorado foreign-entity record, not used. Registry data via third-party aggregator, not bizfileonline directly.

profile.summary: A Bakersfield, California firm that helps schools and libraries with technology planning and E-Rate funding, a federal program that subsidizes telecommunications and internet access. Its services include technology design, project administration and architectural support for low-voltage systems. The company now presents itself as Infinity Communications & Compliance.

sources.title: Infinity Communications & Consulting, Inc. Bakersfield, CA - filing information

review.notes: Identity is well supported (CA SOS entity 2474557 and BBB list Infinity Communications & Consulting, Inc. at 4909 Calloway Dr, Bakersfield, sharing phone/fax with infinitycomm.com, whose footer links an 'Infinity Communications & Consulting Inc.' profile). However, the summary says the firm serves 'schools and libraries' and none of the fetched pages (contact, home, E-Rate) mention libraries, only schools, so the summary is not fully supported and must be regenerated.
